_doc: Single source of timing for picture (video/) and score (music/). Seconds. 120 BPM: beat = 0.5 s, bar = 2 s. 60 fps: beat = 30 frames. Every cue below is drawn on screen at exactly this time and voiced in the score at exactly this time.

scenes.what: Ink world. Headline plate «هنوز توی دایرکت می‌فروشی؟». Customer bubbles («قیمت؟», «موجوده؟» …) pop in on an accelerating grid until the screen floods; at 3.75 everything freezes and is sucked into one point.
Near silence. A caret types «تو فقط بگو…» one key per 16th note.
DROP 1. Mascot (waving) rises on a glowing disc; six job chips land around it one per beat; «هوش مصنوعی اپیتو — یک گفت‌وگو، همه‌ی کارها». 9.5 the violet design chip zooms to fill the frame.

Design Studio. Plain default store in a phone; the prompt «یک طرح تازه برای فروشگاهم بساز» is typed (10.1–11.5), held, sent at 12.0 (DROP 2). Its letters fly into the store and each section transforms on a beat (12.5, 13.0, 13.5, 14.0) into the dark roastery design. Hold. 16.0–17.5 «طراحی سریع» reshuffles the hero on every beat. 18.0 tap «انتشار» → «منتشر شد», address bar ghahvekhane.appito.app.

Photo Studio. Mascot with camera; 21.0 shutter + white flash; a sneaker shot on a busy home rug; 22.0–22.6 a scan line wipes the background to a clean studio card with a shadow. 24.0/24.5/25.0 three rows of messy photos snap into identical cards (one row per beat); 25.5/26.0 the card backgrounds change colour; 27.5 phone buzz.

Bale bot (no Bale logo/UI; neutral chat). 28.0 notification lands; 28.75 tap opens chat; 29.0 order message with buttons; 30.5 tap «تأیید واریز»; 31.0 bot asks again («پول با دو تأیید»); riser; 33.75 tap «بله، تأیید»; 34.0 the music STOPS and a giant «بله.» slams in; 35.0 confirmation reply; 36.0 the beat drops back.
DROP 3. Three handicraft photos + «از این عکس‌ها محصول بساز»; three product cards fill on beats; 38.5 tap «همه را تأیید کن».
Voice note: 40.0 record starts (waveform), 41.0 stops and is transcribed, 42.0/42.5/43.0 caption, hashtags and story cards pop; 43.25 «کپی شد».
Nine feature tiles land one per beat (44.0 … 48.0), the full wall holds 48.0–49.5 for reading, 49.5 it collapses into the end card.

End card. 50.0 IMPACT; «تو» 50.0, «فقط» 50.25, «بگو،» 50.5, «اپیتو می‌سازدش» 51.0; 52.0 glowing disc + mascot + appito wordmark; 53.0 CTA «ساخت فروشگاه» + myappito.com; hold; 56.0 cuts back to frame 0.

sections.music: No drums. Low G drone/pad (filtered), the pings ARE the riser: each ping a pitched bell/pluck climbing the Shur scale; rising noise underneath from 2.0.
Glitch + tape-stop/reverse-suck as the flood is vacuumed into one point. Hard stop at 4.0.
Near silence: only key clicks and a very soft sub/drone; reverse swell 5.0→6.0.
First drop, light: kick + tombak/daf percussion + bass; santur hook first statement; chip pops on beats.
Filtered groove under the typing, riser 11.0→11.875, then a gap of silence 11.875→12.0.
Main drop on the SEND. Build snaps 12.5/13.0/13.5/14.0. Shuffle hits 16.0/16.5/17.0/17.5.
Publish tap + success chime at 18.0; fill + whoosh 19.5→20.0.
Groove variation; the camera shutter is part of the kit (21.0 big, 24.0/24.5/25.0 snaps); scan sweep 22.0–22.6; colour ticks 25.5/26.0.
No kick. Pad + santur tremolo, chime at 28.0, taps/pops, riser 31.0→33.75 with accelerating pulse 33.0→33.75.
33.75 tap; 34.0 ONE huge impact for «بله.» then total silence except its tail until 35.0.
Full groove back. Product cards (36–40) then the voice kit (40–44): small pops/ticks on the cues; a short stop at 40.0 for the record blip is welcome.
Climax groove; one hit per tile 44.0…48.0; hook doubled.

50.0 biggest impact; word slams 50.0/50.25/50.5/51.0; 52.0 shimmer for the glowing disc; 53.0 CTA pop; final santur cadence resolves to G by ~54; drums out at 54.0; tail rings to 56.0 and is silent by 55.95 so the loop cut is clean.

cues.note: dense chatter of tiny pings (64ths) on top of the last pings
